claims.claim: Reasoning training was an imitation problem; Negative Self-Distillation reframes it as active avoidance.
claims.summary_span: Reasoning training was an imitation problem; Negative Self-Distillation reframes it as active avoidance.
claims.source_span: OPSD has emerged as a popular paradigm for large language model (LLM) self-improvement, allowing models to act as their own teachers by leveraging privileged information such as ground-truth solutions... we introduce Negative Self-Distillation (NSD), a new framework that optimizes LLMs by diverging from flawed reasoning rather than imitating privileged solutions.
claims.note: 'Imitation problem' accurately characterises OPSD and 'active avoidance' accurately characterises NSD's divergence-based approach per the source.
